change: Minimize cycled previews three seconds after prefix release and animate amber busy dots in expanded headers.

verified: Holding the prefix for more than three seconds keeps the selected preview expanded.
Prefix release permits the full three-second delay and then folds the preview while retaining its tab.
A macro prefix released before Tab starts a countdown on cycling; subsequent cycling replaces that countdown.
Re-pressing the prefix suspends a countdown until release.
Manual expansion cancels the keyboard countdown.
All three amber busy dots remain visible and animate with unchanged message cards.
Default and custom shortcut cycling preserve exact chat activation and live tab limits.
nativeDesktopTests.scope: Owned Windows overlays and simulated shortcut-thread events; no keyboard events were injected into desktop applications. The physical OEM Copilot key was not exercised.
